messages:
mika: Heads-up: new deal - gov agency wants an air-gapped on-prem POC. Key asks: encrypted physical media, offline activation flow, signed SBOM, monthly security-only deltas, and a clear pricing band for offline packaging + signing. Pilot window: 8 weeks. @rahul can you own tech presales?

rahul: Yep. Quick clarifiers for scoping: 1) preferred media type (SSD vs encrypted USB)? 2) any hard single-file size cap? 3) do they require vendor HSM or customer keypair? 4) is telemetry banned entirely?

jess: They prefer encrypted NVMe cartridges but will accept multiple signed USBs if capacity limited. Telemetry must be opt-out and default-off. They want chain-of-custody logs for every handoff.

frank: Ops notes: recommend NVMe for >128GB. For single artifacts >40GB we convert to multipart with resume support. We include a small installer tool that verifies signatures offline and supports chunk resume.

frank: Example manifest we include (integrity):

```
manifest_version: 1
artifacts:
  - name: model-v2-int8.bin
    parts: ["p001","p002"]
    sha256: deadbeef...
signed_by: redwood-release
provenance: provenance-v2.tar.gz
```

mika: Security questionnaire flagged: FIPS-compliant signing, cert rotation without internet, reproducible build logs for quantized artifacts, and escrow options for signing keys.

rahul: We support three signing modes: 1) customer-supplied keypair (we sign locally with their private key), 2) vendor HSM with customer-managed keys (no escrow), 3) vendor HSM with escrow (additional cost). All can be FIPS-compliant. Note: HSM procurement lead time can be 6+ weeks if customer requests on-prem HSM.

jess: Activation flows we can offer: CSR -> signed activation token -> offline import, or signed license file bound to HW fingerprint. Both fully offline. Documented import steps + verification included.

frank: Delta cadence: monthly security-only deltas + quarterly feature bundles is doable. Caveat: quantized-delta generation often needs a full image rebuild to validate memory layout; typical delta prep: 24-72h depending on model size. We'll call that out in SOW.

mika: Buyer asked for a ballpark for offline packaging & signing + one week of on-site validation. Need a number to include in the proposal.

jess: Ballpark commercial: $28k-60k for offline packaging/signing service depending on artifact count and HSM work. On-site validation billed separately. Final price after BOM + acceptance criteria.

security-bot: Reminder: include export control clause for quantized models. Also require signed SBOM and provenance tarball for reproducibility.

rahul: Acceptance checklist proposal to include in SOW: 
- delivered media validates against offline CA
- SBOM + signed provenance delivered
- installer runs without DNS/Internet
- chunked install resumes after interruption
- cert rotation tested in staging offline rig
- rollback to previous signed bundle within 4 hours

mika: Ops question: threshold for multi-disk shipping? frank: Flag >40GB single artifact -> multipart; >120GB -> NVMe recommended; >500GB -> special courier/SNEAKERNET planning.

rahul: Action items: 1) Mika to collect BOM + media preference (ETA EOD). 2) Jess to draft SOW addendum with pricing band and acceptance checklist. 3) Frank to run chunked-install and cert-rotation smoke on staging offline rig and post logs by Thur. 4) Security to confirm FIPS/hsm options and escrow timeline.

mika: Thanks team. I'll message the buyer tonight with the three signing options and the preliminary price band. Will attach recommended NVMe + signed manifest approach as our preferred solution.

frank: FYI - staging airgap rig maintenance window: 2026-04-05 03:00-05:00 UTC, good slot for tests.

jess: Also note: if customer insists on vendor-produced quantized models, include reproducible build flags and signed build logs as deliverables.

mika: Closing - keep thread for tracker. Will update when BOM arrives.
